name: Toriko no Shizuku ~Natsu no Gouka Kyakusen de Kegasareru Otome-tachi~
original_name: 虜ノ雫 ～夏の豪華客船で穢される処女たち～
source:
Fujigasaki Miho, a student at a girls' school, lost her mother, an oceanographer, a few years ago and was living with her father. Her father was the captain of the cruise ship Northern Light, but after her mother's death, he stepped off the boat.

However, Miho noticed that her father wanted to return to the ship someday. When an old coworker urged him to return, she offered a hesitant father one final push to do it. At that time, Miho was already able to do more or less all the domestic chores. His return was then arranged. After some time as first mate, it was decided that the father would officially return to the captain position. It would occur on the anniversary of the Northern Light's 200th cruise.

At that time, Miho's close friend, Moribe Jun, gave her a suggestion. Since she was hired for a short-term part-time job on that anniversary cruise, they could have worked together. Miho decided to accept the offer because it would only last for the summer holiday and Jun would also be present. It was therefore determined that she would go on the cruise, which would mark her father's return to his role as the captain of the ship.

The time of the summer holiday has come. After a few days of induction courses, the voyage has finally begun. While struggling to do the unfamiliar job, the protagonist made friends with different people, including Kurusu Nonoka, an idol who was in charge of events on the ship; Otowa Saki, a student who was studying violin; and Mizunashi Nadia, a casino dealer—and was spending fulfilling days.

[i]This summer vacation will become a memory for the rest of her life... 
Miho was confident of it, but she had not imagined in her wildest dreams that a nightmare awaited her beyond.[/i]

[Translated from the [url=http://www.guilty-soft.com/product/torikonoshizuku/story.html]official site[/url]]
translation:
女子学校学生藤ヶ崎美帆几年前失去了身为海洋学家的母亲，此后一直与父亲相依为命。父亲曾是北极光号邮轮的船长，却在母亲去世后离开了这艘船。

然而，美帆发现父亲始终希望有一天能重返邮轮。一位昔日同事劝他回来时，她也推了犹豫的父亲一把。此时，美帆已经基本能够独立料理家务，父亲的回归便安排了下来。他先担任了一段时间的大副，之后决定在北极光号第200次航行的纪念航次上，正式重新出任船长。

这时，美帆的好友守部润向她提出建议：润已被聘为这次纪念航程的短期兼职人员，她们可以一起工作。因为工作只持续一个暑假，润也会在场，美帆便接受了邀约。于是，她将搭上这趟象征父亲重返船长职位的航程。

暑假到了。经过几天的入职培训，航程终于开始。虽然还在努力适应陌生的工作，美帆却结识了各种各样的朋友，包括负责船上活动的偶像来栖乃乃果、学习小提琴的学生音羽咲希，以及赌场荷官水梨Nadia，过着充实的每一天。

[i]这个暑假会成为伴随一生的回忆……
美帆对此深信不疑，却做梦也没想到，前方等待着她的竟是一场噩梦。[/i]
